First Aid Combat Styles

Choose First Aid perks to heal allies, clear conditions, or prepare with combat consumables.

First Aid - Trauma Medic

Trauma Medic uses medical supplies to heal one target and remove conditions such as Bleed or Poison.

First Aid - Combat Pharmacology

Combat Pharmacology uses stim packs for resource recovery and temporary defenses.
